content:
The database contains the following tables:

1. **branch_finance_kpis**
   - Columns: 
     - kpi_id (bigint)
     - report_month (date)
     - branch_name (text)
     - region (text)
     - revenue_usd (numeric)
     - operating_expense_usd (numeric)
     - net_profit_usd (numeric)
     - new_loans_count (integer)
     - approved_loans_count (integer)
     - deposits_usd (numeric)
     - loan_default_rate_pct (numeric)
     - customer_accounts (integer)
     - avg_transaction_value_usd (numeric)
     - created_at (timestamp without time zone)

2. **finance_economics_dataset**
   - Columns: 
     - Date (text)
     - Stock Index (text)
     - Open Price (double precision)
     - Close Price (double precision)
     - Daily High (double precision)
     - Daily Low (double precision)
     - Trading Volume (bigint)
     - GDP Growth (%) (double precision)
     - Inflation Rate (%) (double precision)
     - Unemployment Rate (%) (double precision)
     - Interest Rate (%) (double precision)
     - Consumer Confidence Index (bigint)
     - Government Debt (Billion USD) (bigint)
     - Corporate Profits (Billion USD) (bigint)
     - Forex USD/EUR (double precision)
     - Forex USD/JPY (double precision)
     - Crude Oil Price (USD per Barrel) (double precision)
     - Gold Price (USD per Ounce) (double precision)
     - Real Estate Index (double precision)
     - Retail Sales (Billion USD) (bigint)
     - Bankruptcy Rate (%) (double precision)
     - Mergers & Acquisitions Deals (bigint)
     - Venture Capital Funding (Billion USD) (double precision)
     - Consumer Spending (Billion USD) (bigint)

3. **market_event_annotations**
   - Columns: 
     - event_id (bigint)
     - Date (text)
     - Stock Index (text)
     - event_type (text)
     - event_title (text)
     - event_summary (text)
     - sentiment (text)
     - expected_market_impact (text)
     - created_at (timestamp without time zone)
